source: single-machine-kvstore's trace generator (evaluator/generate.py zipf), copied into the run and frozen by prepare.py
size: load_count keys preloaded and run_count run keys per draw (defaults 1,000,000 and 2,000,000)

dimensions.key_distribution: scrambled Zipf, theta 0.99, over the preloaded key ids
dimensions.key_encoding: each key id as a zero-padded decimal String; width = digits of load_count (7 for 1,000,000), so string order matches numeric order
dimensions.value_type: i32: the low 32 bits of a SplitMix64 hash of the key id (preload) or of operation index XOR key id (writes)
dimensions.operation_mix: independent deterministic 50:50 get/put choices; the trace wraps if exhausted
dimensions.timed_operations: get and put only; scan and sort are verified but not timed
dimensions.draws: scored: seed 211, operation seed 213 (every checkpoint); held-out: seed 223, operation seed 225 (checked before a new best, never a score)
